title: From Perspective to Fisheye Depth Estimation and Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2608.27860v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision foundation models are capable of generalizing across 3-dimensional (3D) scenes with high-fidelity estimates; their empirical success can be attributed to training on large-scale datasets of perspective images. However, when transferred to wide field-of-view (FoV) images, such as those captured by fisheye cameras, they return erroneous outputs due to a covariate shift stemming from the radial distortion on the image pixels. We propose a method to generalize vision foundation models to fisheye cameras. The crux of our method lies in a set of learnable parameters, termed Distortion Extenders (DEX), that model the fisheye distortion coefficients and the distributional shift between fisheye and perspective images encoded in the latent space. translated_title: 从透视到鱼眼的深度估计与开放词汇分割
translated_abstract: 视觉基础模型能够以高保真的估计结果泛化到各种三维（3D）场景，其经验上的成功可归因于在大规模透视图像数据集上的训练。然而，当迁移到宽视场（FoV）图像（例如由鱼眼相机拍摄的图像）时，由于图像像素的径向畸变所引起的协变量偏移，这些模型会产生错误的输出。我们提出了一种将视觉基础模型泛化到鱼眼相机的方法。该方法的核心在于一组可学习参数，称为畸变扩展器（Distortion Extenders, DEX），用于建模鱼眼畸变系数以及鱼眼图像与透视图像之间在潜在空间中编码的分布偏移。通过最小化自监督对齐损失，DEX 将鱼眼图像的潜在嵌入转换为类似于透视图像的嵌入，从而恢复高保真的估计结果。DEX 是一种
tldr: 该论文提出名为“畸变扩展器（DEX）”的可学习参数方法，通过自监督对齐损失将鱼眼图像的潜在嵌入映射到透视图像的嵌入空间，使视觉基础模型能够泛化到鱼眼相机，实现高保真的深度估计与开放词汇分割。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Distortion Extenders (DEX), a set of learnable parameters that model fisheye distortion and the distributional shift between fisheye and perspective images, enabling vision foundation models to generalize to fisheye cameras for high-fidelity depth estimation and open-vocabulary segmentation via a self-supervised alignment loss.
